form.label: Container runtime and systemd service logs - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for Docker json-file, CRI runtime, Docker Engine event, systemd/journald service, and Docker journald-driver container records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime") host=$host_tok$ (stream=stderr OR message="*error*" OR container_log="*error*") | stats count
index=osnix (sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | stats count by sourcetype vendor product action | sort -count

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | eval action=coalesce(action,"-"), stream=coalesce(stream,"-"), event_type=coalesce(event_type,"-"), service_unit=coalesce(service_unit,"-"), program=coalesce(program,"-") | stats count by action stream event_type service_unit program | sort -count

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime") host=$host_tok$ (stream=stderr OR message="*error*" OR container_log="*error*") | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product stream cri_flag action message container_log signature signature_id marker_family _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="docker:engine:event" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product event_type action container_id signature signature_id marker_family Type Action Actor.ID Actor.Attributes.name Actor.Attributes.image scope time timeNano _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product service_unit program severity action message signature signature_id marker_family _HOSTNAME _SYSTEMD_UNIT SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER PRIORITY _TRANSPORT MESSAGE _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="docker:journald:container" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product container_id container_name image_name stream action message signature signature_id marker_family CONTAINER_ID CONTAINER_ID_FULL CONTAINER_NAME IMAGE_NAME _HOSTNAME SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER MESSAGE _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker_family) as fixture_markers values(vendor) as vendors values(product) as products min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=osnix (sourcetype="docker:container:json_file" OR sourcetype="container:cri:runtime" OR sourcetype="docker:engine:event" OR sourcetype="systemd:journald:service" OR sourcetype="docker:journald:container") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product stream cri_flag event_type action container_id container_name image_name service_unit program severity message container_log signature signature_id marker_family _raw | sort -_time | head 50
